d: Vibrant crimson hair with orange gradient tips is styled into two small side braids and thick bangs. The eyes are a shimmering purple shade with a wide, innocent expression on a youthful, childlike face. This petite build wears a white sailor-style top with a light blue collar, a matching light blue necktie, and a dark blue pleated mini-skirt, paired with a white sailor cap featuring a navy blue ribbon. Signature details include brown leather belts strapped around the thighs and a brown shoulder strap crossing the chest.
